['Schott AG '].company_description: Schott AG is an international technology group and inventor of specialty glass. It has achieved strong growth in the United States, with U.S. sales of over $520 million in fiscal year 2021-22. The company's SCHOTT MINIFAB division offers solutions for contract design and manufacturing of rapid diagnostics devices. Additionally, Schott AG plans to raise at least €813 million from the initial public offering of its specialty medical-glassware unit.
